name: bōm

menus.name: Chef's tasting menu
menus.note: Served at the marble chef's counter: small seafood and vegetable courses, then meats grilled at the counter, a traditional Korean rice, banchan and soup course, and desserts. Exploratory wine pairing $245 (Tradition pairing $550, non-alcoholic $115), from the wine list (bom-nyc.com/s/wine-list-1.pdf).

alsoTry.name: Oiji Mi
alsoTry.note: Its sister restaurant at the front of the same building, also one Michelin star and led by Brian Kim: a five-course prix fixe, with à la carte in the bar and lounge.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, for parties of one to six. There are two sittings: 5:30pm and 8:30pm Tuesday to Saturday, 5pm and 8pm on Sunday. The full menu price is paid when booking.
